component.name: AI Usage Monitor
component.summary: Verify AI usage, spend, and local coding activity in Plasma

description.p: AI Usage Monitor is a Plasma 6 widget for provider-reported usage and spend, local coding-tool activity, balances, rate limits, and read-only connection checks. Guided setup verifies one useful source with a safe read-only request and states what the result can prove.

The widget stores secrets in KWallet and history on the local computer. Overview keeps reported data, estimates, balances, and connectivity separate. Native diagnostics checks plugin versions, install layers, database health, and source readiness. The KDE Store frontend requires the matching compiled plugin from the Fedora COPR package or a source build.
